content.short: European mobile finance app with accounts, cards and investing.
content.description: Vivid Money is a European mobile finance app, headquartered in Germany, that combines everyday banking with investing and rewards in one account. Users get a current account with IBAN, physical and virtual cards, sub-accounts ('Pockets') for organizing and sharing money, cashback rewards, and the ability to invest in stocks, ETFs, and other assets, with crypto exposure in some markets, plus dedicated business accounts. Vivid positions itself as a financial super app for people who want to spend, save, and invest without juggling separate providers, targeting retail customers across several European countries. By blending banking, multi-currency features, investing, and cashback into a single polished app, Vivid competes with other European challengers like Revolut and N26 for consumers seeking an all-in-one money and investment platform.
